- Subprocessor notice: For a short POC term we can accept the 30-day notice Helix requested (concession limited to POC engagement only). We'll add a clause that returns to Redwood's standard 14-day notice for any extension/production agreement.

Proposed flow: Redwood legal prepares final DPA+SCC exhibit -> internal review -> DocuSign envelope to Helix primary sig (Catherine) -> counterparty e-sign -> executed copies to both parties. Target timeline: final DPA to Helix within 24 hours and signature within 48 hours after sending (assuming no further material redlines).
